I have 2 houserule for Expatriette's tutor cards.

Arsenal Access: Select a card type - Equipment, Gun or Ammo. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal 2 cards of that type. Put both of them into you hand. Shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your deck. You may play a card.

Quick Draw: If both "Pride" and "Prejudice" are in play, search your deck for a Gun card and put it into play. If not, search your trash or your deck for either "Pride" or "Prejudice" and put it into play. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck.

Mainly helps her get what she wants when she needs.

The SMG variant ended up making it a much more interesting choice for pretty much any situation. The pride/prejudice changes were even better, though, as they weren't quite so interchangeable and single target/card draw combo seemed quite useful without being ridiculous.  

 

My custom deck ended up making her an "every other turn" character- one turn to get things ready, and one turn to let loose.  

I ended up changing pretty much everything- I added a new gun (a 50 cal. Sniper rifle named "Citizen Friendly") that could only be fired if there was ammo in it, and you had to use a power or one-shot to load it.  But in return it did massive (5 points) irreducible damage.

I added a new ongoing- the Black Market.  Every time you destroyed an ammo card, you drew a card.  And at the end of turn, if you didn't have any guns in play or in hand, you drew cards until you got one.

I also tweaked all the ammo and increased the amount in the deck, at the cost of reducing amount of one shots- but I bulked them up so that when you got to play one, it was awesome.

I ended up changing the vest so that it always provided a damage reduction of 1, but the 3 point prevention check came first- so a heavy hit would make it go away, but it would protect you until then.

So far its working good.  She's become a steady damage dealer, with some bursts when things align.   Its a lot easier for her to get the various guns, though there is still an element of "use what you have"  In return, she has more group-synergy friendly ammo (one increases damage taken, another reduces damage froma  target by two..but only if they took damage from the gun after any reductions), and more of it.

 

Oh, and I named all the guns.  Because I figure she's the type of person who names all of her firearms.

Sniper Rifle (Citizen Friendly, because it really helps people open up, and show what they are like on the inside)

SMG: Group therapy (because she has anger issues)

Rifle: Date Night (because the firing range is a great first date...and what you bring and how you shoot will determine if there is a second one)

Shotgun: Ol' Hateful (It reminds her of her mother, especially when she pulls the trigger)

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
I changed speed loading, precisely because that specific combo was proving too powerful, especially with the sniper rifle.

Speed loading became: Start of turn, you may play an ammo. When this card is played, you may play an ammo card.

So, speed loading now has an immediate benefit, but you can't recycle ammo except with Reload (and there are only two of those).  But there are 12 ammo cards, so you'll have ammo coming up more frequently with the added card draws.

 

The other major change I made involved the two big guns (assault rifle and shotgun).  After using the power, you'd have to destroy an ammo, or the gun itself.  Pride/prejudice and the SMG just destroyed ammo after use, so you could fire them without loading.  It makes using the shotgun/assault rifle something you have to prepare for- or you have to be willing to lose them.
